blocks.text: Roshni ki nature (asal pehchan) kya hai? Yeh sawal kaafi mushkil nikla. Kya roshni energy ko aik jagah se doosri jagah wave (lehar) ki shakal mein le jati hai, ya particles (bohat chhote zarre) ki stream (dhaar) ki shakal mein? Wave aik chalti hui disturbance (halchal) hai jo energy le ja sakti hai, aur roshni kai phenomena (qudrati waqiaat) mein wave jaisa behaviour (rawayya) dikhati hai. Doosri waves ke muqable mein roshni ki nature aasani se pata nahi chalti, kyunke yeh khud ko saaf taur par nahi dikhati. Roshni ke wave hone ka idea sab se pehle 1678 mein Christiaan Huygens ne diya. Us waqt is ke haq mein experimental evidence (tajurbe se saboot) mazboot nahi tha, is liye Newton ki 1672 wali corpuscular theory (roshni chhote zarron ki bani hai) zyada mashhoor aur zyada maani hui thi. 1801 mein Young ke interference experiment ne sabit kiya ke roshni wave hai, aur yun Huygens ki wave theory pakki ho gayi. 1860 mein Maxwell ne roshni ko electromagnetic waves mana. Un ke mutabiq oscillating (aage peeche jhoolte) electric charges badalte hue electric aur magnetic fields banate hain. Yeh fields aik doosre ko baar baar dobara paida karti hain aur vacuum (khaali jagah jahan hawa bhi na ho) mein bhi aage chal sakti hain. Beesvi sadi (twentieth century) ke shuru mein quantum mechanics ne bataya ke roshni ki dual nature (do tarah ki pehchan) hai: experiment ke mutabiq kabhi wave wali aur kabhi particle wali properties nazar aati hain. Roshni electromagnetic wave ki tarah chalti hai, lekin matter (maadda) ke saath alag alag, massless (bina mass ke) particles ki tarah milti hai jinhein photons kehte hain. Phir bhi roshni ki wave theory ab bhi sahi hai aur roshni ke kaafi waqiaat kamyabi se samjhati hai. Is chapter mein hum roshni ki woh properties parhenge jo us ke wave hone se judi hain, jaise interference aur diffraction.

blocks.prompt: Kis experiment ne roshni ki wave theory qaim ki, aur kab?

items: Huygens (1678): roshni wave hai; Newton (1672): roshni particles (corpuscles, chhote zarre) hai.
Young (1801): interference ne roshni ka wave hona sabit kiya; Maxwell (1860): roshni electromagnetic waves hai.
Quantum mechanics: roshni ki dual nature (wave bhi, particle bhi); matter se photons ki shakal mein milti hai.
Is chapter mein: interference aur diffraction.
